task:
FIX TWO CONFIRMED REVIEW FINDINGS ON PR #793. Target branch codex/run-37990139541-1, expected head 475e565; fail closed if it moved. Only scripts/checks/prod_version_drift.py, deploy/v3-production/promotion-hold.json, tests/test_prod_version_drift.py, tests/test_deploy_drift_contract.py and docs/operations/v3-production-application-release.md (hold subsection) may change.

FINDING 1 (hold silently covers commits merged after it was reviewed): add a required key covers_main_sha (40-hex) to the hold file = the main commit the hold was reviewed against. Semantics: a deployable commit is COVERED by the hold if it is an ancestor of (or equal to) covers_main_sha; deployable commits in live..main that are NOT ancestors of covers_main_sha are UNCOVERED and go through the normal staleness analysis exactly as today (grace, lag, exit 1 when stale). In main(): after computing deployable_commits_behind(), classify each with is_ancestor(commit_sha, covers_main_sha, repo) (reuse the existing helper); pass covered/uncovered lists (or a per-commit flag) into decide(). In decide(), when live == held_live_sha and the hold is active: if there are no uncovered deployable commits -> exit 0 'HELD: ...' as today but say 'N covered deployable commit(s) acknowledged by the hold (reviewed against <covers_main_sha[:12]>)'; if uncovered commits exist -> run the normal staleness decision over the UNCOVERED commits only, prefix the output with 'HOLD COVERS <n> commit(s) up to <covers_main_sha[:12]>; <m> deployable commit(s) merged AFTER the hold are NOT covered:' and list them, so a later hotfix alerts normally once it exceeds the grace period; extending the hold requires a reviewed PR that bumps covers_main_sha. Validate at load time that covers_main_sha is 40-hex and, in main(), that it is an ancestor of (or equal to) main_sha; otherwise exit 3 'INVARIANT VIOLATION: promotion hold covers_main_sha is not on origin/main'. Set covers_main_sha in the committed hold file to the exact origin/main commit this branch is based on (find it with git merge-base origin/main HEAD and state it in your summary); the reviewer will confirm it.

FINDING 2 (future held_since): if held_since (as midnight UTC of that date) is later than now_epoch, the hold is not yet active: treat it as INVALID and exit 3 'INVARIANT VIOLATION: promotion hold file invalid: held_since is in the future' (fail closed; a hold must never activate before its declared start, and the 45-day limit must be measured from a real start). Implement the check where now_epoch is available (decide() or a validation step in main() that receives now_epoch), and keep load_promotion_hold() pure.

TESTS: add cases for: covered-only -> 0 with the covered count; uncovered commit within grace -> 0 with the 'NOT covered' prefix; uncovered commit beyond grace -> 1; covers_main_sha not on main -> 3; future held_since -> 3; missing covers_main_sha key -> 3. Update the workflow doc subsection: extending a hold = bump covers_main_sha (and expires_at if needed) in a reviewed PR, which is how each later deployable change is consciously acknowledged. Keep every existing test passing. VALIDATE and report: ruff; python -m pytest tests/test_prod_version_drift.py tests/test_deploy_drift_contract.py -q; git diff --name-only showing only allowed paths.
